        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())

        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        return self.run_dir
evidence.reason: The current claim path creates the record base and the run directory, then returns without fsyncing either directory entry. `durable_write` on the receipt can only persist the receipt and its parent run directory; it cannot persist the record-base entry that names the run directory. A crash after admission can therefore leave the host held while losing the run directory and its prior SHA/trigger state. This is an ordinary durability defect in the intended `durable_write`/recovery behavior, not a new hardening requirement.
